round3.where: A new unsaved section on the page Blocks Probe, left by Exit Without Saving. A 1600 by 1000 window, the panel at left 814 top 301.
round3.directionRule: Fitted to five cases: the spread of the block centres, wider than tall gives a row, else a column.

children.click: A click, a second click and a double click on a child keep the stack selected with its toolbar.
children.drag: A drag on a child moves the whole stack; the order stays.
children.phoneArea: Phones use the column rule whatever the direction (1 / 2 / 10 / 10).

position.row: left, center, right set justify-content; top, center, bottom set align-items

corner.backToUniform: the top left value for all four

fitButton.note: A Button that has been in a stack keeps its own width; a fresh one fills its block.

round3.link: The same link editor as buttons, under the link button. Typing a link changes nothing the editor shows; its effect on the page cannot be read without Save.

layers.click: A row selects its child inside the stack: Shape shows Edit, Align Vertically, Duplicate, Remove, with no Pin.
layers.drag: A row dragged above another reorders the children: Text, Shape became Shape, Text.
